questions.question: ‘Cardiologist’ is related to ‘Heart’ in the same way as ‘Chiropractor’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
Cardiologist is a doctor who treats ailments related to heart

Similarly,

Chiropractor is a healthcare professional whose practice involves the treatment of ailments related to joints.

Hence, 'Chiropractor' is related to Joints'.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair.

Spoke : Wheel
questions.solution:
A bunch of Spokes makes a wheel.

Similarly,

A group of words makes a sentence.

Hence, “word : sentence” is the correct answer.

questions.question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a415a7153a671b8a4eacfd47bd7c3a29462a5bcc3bcaa83eb673443fa1de7aa4.png]
questions.solution:
Given series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/409950cbcc2595897da48422eed0fc7e84205cdc8f9315786f5dc7389599ac24.png] 

The shapes in images A and C are combined to create the shape in B. Also, in B, we can see that the shape in C is inserted inside the shape in A, i.e., A is the outer figure and C is the inner figure. 

Note that the outer figure is not the same as the inner figure.

Similarly,

when we combine C and E, we get the shape in D. Here C is the outer figure and E is the inner figure.

Now, to maintain the pattern of the series, the next image must be a combination of the shape in E (circle) and another shape (which is not a circle) such that the shape in A will form the outer figure.

Hence, the image in option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some essays are poems.

Some poems are directors.

All directors are singers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some directors are poems.

II. Some singers are essays.

III. Some singers are poems.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2314352b3a6b83e61cec2e8aa2cd35634735a12154c918527ba39126ba20ca47.png] 

I. Some directors are poems → True (as some poems are directors)

II. Some singers are essays → False (it is possible but not definite).

III. Some singers are poems → True (Some poems are directors and All directors are singers. This would mean that some poems are singers.)

**Note:** Some A are B ⇒ Some B are A.

Hence, “only conclusions I and III follow” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number opposite to the face having 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d5bf87ca4e5c2055eec42d92b1cc5468010264b0e87c02b180cf5c25ef48651.png]
questions.solution:
If two elements are the same on two different positions of the same dice, then the remaining elements visible on that dice are opposite to each other i.e. 2 will be opposite to 4.

Alternately,

The faces containing the numbers 1 and 5 are adjacent to the face containing 2 as well as the face containing 4.

Therefore, the face containing 2 is opposite to the face having 4.

Hence, “2” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Rahul has Rs. 340 in the denominations of Rs. 2 notes, Rs. 5 notes and Rs. 10 notes. The number of notes of each denomination is equal. What is the total number of notes that Rahul has?
questions.solution:
Let the number of notes of each denomination be ‘x’.

Total number of notes with Rahul = x + x + x = 3x

Therefore, total amount with Rahul = 2x + 5x + 10x = 17x

Thus, we have 17x = 340 and x = 20

Therefore, total number of notes is 20 × 3 = 60

Hence, 60 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

54 : 41 :: 32 : ____
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The sum of squares of both the digits is written on the right side.

54 : 41 = (5)² + (4)² = 25 + 16 = 41

Similarly,

32 : ? = (3)² + (2)² = 9 + 4 = 13

Hence, “13” is the correct answer.
